---- MODULE Case ----
EXTENDS Naturals, TLC
(* --algorithm A begin L:either skip; or skip; end either; B:skip; end algorithm *)
====
generated_body:
VARIABLE pc

vars == << pc >>

Init == /\ pc = "L"

L == /\ pc = "L"
     /\ \/ /\ TRUE
        \/ /\ TRUE
     /\ pc' = "B"

B == /\ pc = "B"
     /\ TRUE
     /\ pc' = "Done"

(* Allow infinite stuttering to prevent deadlock on termination. *)
Terminating == pc = "Done" /\ UNCHANGED vars

Next == L \/ B
           \/ Terminating

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

Termination == <>(pc = "Done")
